results.title: Red Dirt
results.overview: When Emma Bennett, a teen girl living in the South, finds out life changing news, she has to find a way to navigate it with the help of her best friend Oliver, all while keeping it a secret from her step brother, Jake.

results.title: Speechless
results.overview: Already feeling like a fish out of water among his straight, British-Jamaican clan, Drew’s anxiety spikes when someone steals the speech he’s meant to give at his sister’s wedding.

results.title: Bermuda Riots Are Different
results.overview: An examination of a decade of race riots between 1968 and 1977, alongside a triangle of colonial influences: Bermuda, Great Britain, and the USA.

results.title: Election Day
results.overview: In the general elections in Türkiye, İlker, who wants to be a ballot box officer, encounters an old friend during the training session. This encounter will make İlker question his ability to make “elections” in his personal life.

results.title: Aa Bata Aama 2
results.overview: An ambitious young man leaves his rural Nepali village to chase success in the city, only to return years later to an empty home and the heartbreaking reality of the sacrifices his parents made.

results.title: The Broken Voice
results.overview: Letters, diaries and secrets left by its protagonists, historical and prior unknown materials revisit the life and death of Federico García Lorca, one of Spain’s most beloved and internationally recognized poets.

results.title: Children Untold
results.original_title: わたしの知らない子どもたち
results.overview: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.

results.title: Farewell
results.overview: After taking his own life beneath their recurrent willow tree, the spirit of the tormented Sergio finds itself in a void. Upon seeing his friend Adolfo holding his lifeless body, he realizes the impact of his death. Desperate, he breaks through the barrier separating the two worlds and attempts to reach out to him.

results.title: Get Undressed
results.overview: After years without seeing each other, Tsumugi goes camping with her former track and field teammates. Their excitement at the reunion fades when a conflict they were never able to resolve resurfaces. What no one can imagine is that they're sleeping on the site of an ancient execution ground, where centuries ago villagers were crucified naked. At night, their spirits emerge to hunt down the campers. And then Tsumugi discovers the only way to survive: by undressing.

results.title: Lāu Tsa-Pôo (Before We Say Goodbye)
results.overview: Two 60-ish Taiwanese men share ambiguous closeness, built on ritual and obscurity in an old local bathhouse. Amidst a near-death accident, the body offers a final confession, revealing a lifetime of repressed desire that surfaces only when time runs out.

results.title: Stickball: The Little Brother of War
results.original_title: Stickball: The Little Brother of War
results.overview: A ragtag women's team of underdogs and outsiders must come together to defeat the incumbent champions, earn ancestral pride for their community, and settle a historic rivalry in the oldest and bloodiest sport in America: Native American Stickball.

results.title: Rolling Mother
results.overview: When Wilhelm decides to sell the house of his deceased mother Hildegard, she unexpectedly returns from the dead - in the shape of a murderous tin can.

results.title: Midnight Train
results.overview: Trapped in the subway crowd, Ella falls asleep, waking up in a world where dreams and reality intertwine, and strange beings offer her an escape from her reality.

results.title: Nayyi Navelli
results.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

results.title: Mercy
results.overview: A tense psychological horror short that follows a young woman trapped in a dangerous and unsettling situation, forcing her to confront fear, survival, and a disturbing reality.
